background: Erste Group is an Austrian bank with the leading retail franchise across Central and Eastern Europe, funded by local deposits in Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania, Hungary and Croatia, and part-owned by its founding savings-bank foundation.
synthesis: All three of the main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average and A at the weakest of them, two on a positive outlook and one on stable, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 21 Apr 2026. Capital reads two ways against EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 14.4% is below the peer median while leverage of 6.4% is above it, the gap reflecting how the balance sheet is risk-weighted and not a shortage of equity. Liquidity is sound, LCR of 149% just below the peer median and NSFR of 137% in the top quarter. The direction of travel is the thing to watch: CET1 is down 1.1 points and leverage 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2024 and NSFR down 7 points since 30 Jun 2025, with LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026), and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
